description: 令和5年度液化石油ガス消費者実態調査の結果について [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本県. 熊本県と一般社団法人熊本県LPガス協会が共同で実施した県内のLPガス消費世帯数調査（令和5年12月末現在）の結果です。. Coverage: 熊本県. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本県. Its tags are 総務部. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
